headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update| Sector: Iron & Steel Products SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key Highlights of the 2QFY27 Result Growth momentum continues as NPC integration begins to bear fruit.
Man Industries (India) Ltd. during 2QFY27 reported Revenue/EBITDA/PAT growth of 45.1%/79.7%/121.7% YoY to Rs 1,210 cr/Rs 184 cr/Rs 82 cr, respectively.
EBITDA margin expanded ~290 bps YoY to 15.2% during the quarter, resulting in highest-ever quarterly EBITDA.
This expansion was driven by the first full quarter contribution from NPC operations.
valuation: Plant commissioning is targeted by Dec’27/Jan’28, followed by application for API license which shall take another 3 months (thereby revenue contribution expected from FY29 onwards).
